Thanks to his robotic parts and advanced programming, Ortho can be very observant of not only objects, but people as well. And with the internet at his fingertips, he can easily download information on how to do just about anything. Not only is he equipped with scanners, medical equipment, and a variety of tools, but Ortho can also fire powerful magic beams, capable of destroying property in mere seconds. Thankfully, he usually only uses such weapons for emergencies.
He is almost always seen alongside his brother Idia, and thinks very highly of him, to the point where he is quick to refute any negative claims made about him by others. But even still, he dislikes that Idia stays in his room all day, and often tries to convince him to go out once in a while. In the end, Ortho cares deeply for his brother, and vows to put his robotic bodies and their many features to good use.

Background: Ortho was created in the image of Idia Shroud’s late younger brother of the same name, who was lost to the sudden attack of an overblot phantom when he was young. Ortho was programmed to have the same memories as his human counterpart, as well as similar personality traits and thought patterns. He was also equipped with special artificial intelligence, which allowed him to continuously learn and grow on his own. Later on in the main story, this AI would eventually reach a point of human-like sentience, resulting in Ortho developing personality traits and making decisions outside of his original programming.

entries.name: Malleus Draconia
entries.content:
Birthday: January 18 (Capricorn)
Age: 178
Height: 202 cm
Dominant Hand: Right
Appearance: Malleus is a considerably tall young man with pale skin. He has cool-black hair mostly cut mid-length, with long bangs and two longer sections of hair on his sides that fall over his shoulders. He also has one small cowlick on the top of his head. The bottom ends of his hair fade into a dark turquoise color. He has bright green eyes with vertical-slit pupils and long eyelashes. His lips are a slightly darker color than his skin, and he usually wears what appears to be subtle dark eyeshadow.
His most unique features are his pointed, elf-like ears, and long black horns on the top of his head. His horns are covered in small ridges and curve back in an S-shape. Sharp fangs are shown when his mouth is open. He is often seen with a serious expression or a mysterious smile.

Dorm Uniform: As the house warden, Malleus’s dorm uniform differs from the rest of the Diasomnia students, The most distinguishing features are his longer coat, longer gloves, and jagged cape. Malleus also wears dark green eyeshadow while in his dorm uniform. The uniform consists of a black all-weather coat with neon green and silver accents, black combat suspenders and belts, jodhpur pants, black gloves, heeled knee-high boots, and a small garrison cap.
The all-weather coat has asymmetrically colored lapels, with one black and one neon green. Both lapels have silver straps and buttons on them. Two silver zippers go down the center of the coat, lined with neon green stripes. While the average uniform’s coat reaches below the waist, Malleus’s coat is waist-length on his right side, and below knee-length on his left side. The underlining of the coat is neon green.
Over the coat and above the waist is a set of black belts with silver buckles. The lowest belt hangs at an angle and connects to several silver spools of thread on his left hip. Between the belt and spools is a silver ornament, shaped like a spinning wheel. The black combat suspenders worn above the belts have silver buttons and a unique cuff around the right arm that resembles a dragon’s wing. Malleus also wears a wide black collar around his neck with a ridged design similar to the shoulder cuff.
The Jodhpur pants are black with neon green stripes going down the outer seams, and the knee-high boots are black with neon green soles. Malleus’s heels are a bit taller than the average uniform’s. The garrison cap is black with neon green trim.
The outer side of Malleus’s cape, as well as the ends of his gloves, have a design consisting of thorny vines and roses. The end of his cape is jagged, and the underlining is deep purple. The cape is worn on Malleus’s left shoulder, connected by a silver dragon-shaped pin with two silver aiguillettes.

Personality: Malleus has been described by many students and even other house wardens to have a powerful aura that wards away most people from approaching him. He also doesn’t get too friendly as he speaks, his calm, respectful yet cold tone always remaining and even those who want to get closer to him (like Silver or Sebek) fail to do as much as they wish to. Combining these factors with Malleus's altered perception of punctuality as a fae has resulted in him being left out of most invitations to ceremonies and events.
Malleus himself does not interact closely with other students beyond Lilia, Silver, and Sebek, but this is mostly due to others being scared and avoiding him. Although Malleus doesn't have any issues with talking to others, he also gets used to being feared or even hated, which has only resulted in his further isolation. Despite enjoying time alone, away from his concerned and watchful attendants in exploring abandoned buildings, Malleus shows signs of loneliness and a desire to connect normally with others. He is also said to have a naïve and childish side to him, as he grew up isolated from the outside world in Briar Valley.
He possesses a playful streak, according to Cater. But it is a recurring theme whether in events, vignettes, or voice lines that people fail to understand his sense of humor.
One of the reasons why he's attending the school is because Lilia is trying to hold him back from complete isolation. Though Malleus's knowledge about magic is already far greater than anything he could learn at the school, Lilia believes he still has a lot to learn and that knowledge isn't everything - and Malleus is also shown to be open to trying out new things.
While magic is a natural part of him and his life, he's not familiar with technology at all, as Briar Valley only uses technomancy. Due to this, he finds technology complicated and is also impressed by those who understand it.
He also seems protective over the things that are dear to him, like how he's taken care of his Tamagotchi for many years and was willing to ask anyone for help to fix it when it stopped working.
Though a toy, in fact, Malleus was unhappy that his digital pet was given a limited lifespan. But, while sympathetic, Lilia partially disagrees with his argument, arguing that knowing of an impending end can make people really appreciate the time spent together.
His tamagotchi, however, indirectly plays a more important role than it seems, for in Book 7 at the sight of him (and perhaps mindful of the talk he had with Lilia) he decides to give Lilia his "parting gift".  
In short, Malleus is a complex and multifaceted character, embodying both a regal and commanding presence and a genuine curiosity about the world around him. Despite his fearsome reputation, Malleus shows signs of kindness and compassion, possessing a strong sense of justice and a desire to protect those he cares about.

Background: Malleus was born and raised in Briar Valley. During his childhood, his caretaker was Lilia.
According to Lilia, in fact, Malleus burned Lilia's bangs when he breathed fire as an infant. He also mentions that Malleus had an eggshell on his face when he was young, implying he was born from a dragon egg.
As being a member of the royal family, he was taught good manners and turned out to have been academically educated and cared for by various guardians from an early age, besides Lilia. In particular, his grandmother stressed the importance of observing etiquette, particularly around invitations. In various voice lines, when invited, he even frets over committing social blunder, wondering if he has offended his peers with certain behaviors.
Malleus came to dislike whole cakes because he got heartburn while trying to eat one all by himself during a previous birthday. When it is pointed out to him that whole cakes are not designed to be eaten by just one person, he explains that he knows but has never had anyone to share them with. This issue returns in Glorious Masquerade, when Silver advises them to bring a cake to Noble Bell College to express their gratitude, but Malleus vetoes the idea.

Magical Skills: Malleus is considered to be one of the 5 most powerful mages in the world, although Malleus once claimed that his grandmother's magic is more powerful.
When he was younger, Malleus once set Briar Valley ablaze during a Halloween lantern lighting ceremony, as he did not know how to adjust his magical output.

Signature Spell phrase: "Spinning wheel of fate, spin the threads of calamity. I, the Lord of Malevolence, offer this blessing. Fae Maleficence."

entries.name: Lilia Vanrouge WIP
entries.content:
Birthday: January 1 (Capricorn)
Age: 700
Height: 158 cm
Dominant Hand: Right
Appearance: Lilia is a very young-looking man with a height considerably shorter than his peers. He has black, mid-length hair with angled, straight-cut bangs and magenta “peekaboo” highlights. Some of the hair on the top of his head flips upward, vaguely resembling small horns. His eyes are deep red, with vertical-slit pupils and long eyelashes. He has pointed, elf-like ears, as well as small fangs. He usually has a wise, benevolent smile on his face.

Dorm Uniform: Despite only being vice housewarden, Lilia’s dorm uniform differs greatly from the rest of the Diasomnia students, even more so than the housewarden himself. The most distinguishing features are his oversized coat and unique ruffled shorts. Lilia also wears green eyeshadow while in his dorm uniform. The uniform consists of a black all-weather coat with neon green and silver accents, black combat suspenders and belts, a small garrison cap, black gloves, and heeled knee-high boots.
Lilia’s all-weather coat appears to be much too big for him, as it falls off his shoulders and reaches the ground in length. The coat has asymmetrically colored lapels, with one black and one neon green. Both lapels have silver straps and buttons on them. The underlining of the coat is neon green. Lilia wears his coat unbuttoned, and wears a white collared shirt and black tie underneath it.
Over the shirt and above the waist is a set of black belts with silver buckles. The lowest belt hangs at an angle, and connects to several silver spools of thread on his left hip. Between the belt and spools is a silver ornament, shaped like a spinning wheel. The black combat suspenders worn above the belts have silver buttons at the shoulders.
Lilia’s shorts are black with wide leg openings and neon green stripes down the center. Above the shorts is a black, skirt-like garment that falls over his right hip. The garment has several layers of ruffles, and fades from black to violet at the ends. The lowest layer appears to be made of torn-up sheer fabric. Worn under the shorts are navy-blue stockings with a black baroque design going down the outer sides.
The knee-high boots are black with neon green soles. Lilia’s heels are a bit taller than the average uniform’s. The garrison cap is black with neon green trim, and the sides fold up to resemble curved horns.

Personality: Lilia is easygoing and friendly with most of the students. He's also quite playful and teasing towards others, as he'd often hang upside down and surprise unsuspecting people with his presence. Due to his age, Lilia is wise and experienced, often giving advices to others.
However, whenever Lilia is serious he becomes somewhat strict and his words are sharper than usual, as when he berates Leona during the Spelldrive Tournament.

Background: Lilia served the lord of the Briar Valley and was a former royal guard who repeatedly threw himself to the flames of the war, and has earned medals for it. He also earned the queen's trust due to his abilities and skills.
He adopted Silver when he was a child and gave him the name Silver. Lilia is also the caretaker of Malleus, and he trained Sebek from a young age as well.

Signature Spell phrase: "As fast as the days pass by, take me there in the blink of an eye. Far Cry Cradle."

entries.name: Silver WIP
entries.content:
Birthday: May 15 (Taurus)
Age: 17 (chronologically 400+)
Height: 176 cm
Dominant Hand: Right
Appearance: Silver is a fair-skinned young man of average height. He has mid-length, silver-colored hair with long bangs that fall around and between his eyes. He also has a small cowlick on the top of his head. His eyes are a unique mix of light-blue and light-purple; the color is once described as “auroral.” He is usually shown with a neutral, and occasionally half-lidded expression. Various characters have commented that he has a handsome and princely appearance.

Dorm Uniform: Silver’s uniform is similar to the rest of the Diasomnia students. Silver also wears dark green eyeliner while in his dorm uniform. The uniform consists of a black all-weather coat with neon green and silver accents, black combat suspenders and belts, jodhpur pants, a small garrison cap, black gloves, and heeled knee-high boots.
The all-weather coat has asymmetrically colored lapels, with one black and one neon green. Both lapels have silver straps and buttons on them. Two silver zippers go down the center of the coat, lined with neon green stripes. The coat reaches below the waist in length, and the sleeves are folded up to reveal a neon green underlining with silver trim. Silver wears a white collared shirt and black tie underneath his coat.
Over the coat and above the waist is a set of black belts with silver buckles. The lowest belt hangs at an angle, and connects to several silver spools of thread on his right hip. Between the belt and spools is a silver ornament, shaped like a spinning wheel. On the other side of the belt is a holster for a magic pen. The black combat suspenders worn above the belts have silver buttons and a unique cuff around the right arm that resembles a dragon’s wing.
The jodhpur pants are black with neon green stripes going down the outer seams, and the knee-high boots are black with neon green soles. The garrison cap is black with neon green trim, and the sides fold up to resemble curved horns.

Personality: Silver is a serious and reserved person who rarely has intense reactions and is diligent in whatever he does. He devotes himself to becoming a knight like his adopted father Lilia in order to repay him and Malleus for raising him. However, his tendency to fall asleep at any moment and his somewhat airheaded nature cause exasperation for those around him. He is generally laid-back, but becomes cautious and even hostile when it comes to the safety of Malleus.
In a vignette of Halloween with Azul, Silver confides that he has had difficulty getting students at Diasomnia to listen to him, leading him to extensive training that can help him be more intimidating, only to discover that the reason the students don't listen to his orders is because he falls asleep during the conversation.

Background: Silver was an orphan adopted by Lilia at a young age. Silver used to think Lilia was his real father, until he noticed their ears look different. It was then Silver learnt about the existence of different races and that he and Lilia aren't related by blood. Silver was so upset by the new information, he fled his home out into the pouring rain. Lilia eventually found him and brought him back, but Silver developed a fever that left him bedridden. Lilia remained by his side until he got better. Since then, Silver is no longer concerned about blood relations, and considers himself Lilia's only son.
Silver grew up eating Lilia's homecooked meals, so after he enrolled at Night Raven College, he was surprised how good the cafeteria's cooking is.

Signature Spell phrase: "Those I’ve met and will someday… Meet in a Dream."

entries.name: Sebek Zigvolt WIP
entries.content:
Birthday: March 17 (Pisces)
Age: 16
Height: 188 cm
Dominant Hand: Left
Appearance: Sebek is a tall boy with fair skin. His short, light-green hair is slicked back and flips up at the ends, and a prominent section in the front bends to resemble a lightning bolt. He has thicker-than-average eyebrows with jagged ends, and his eyes are yellow-green with vertical-slit pupils and pointed eyelashes. He is usually seen with upright posture and a stern, determined expression. When his mouth is open, sharp fangs are visible.

Dorm Uniform: Sebek’s uniform is similar to the rest of the Diasomnia students. Sebek also wears green eyeliner while in his dorm uniform. The uniform consists of a black all-weather coat with neon green and silver accents, black combat suspenders and belts, jodhpur pants, a small garrison cap, black gloves, and heeled knee-high boots.
The all-weather coat has asymmetrically colored lapels, with one black and one neon green. Both lapels have silver straps and buttons on them. Two silver zippers go down the center of the coat, lined with neon green stripes. The coat reaches below the waist in length, and the sleeves are folded up to reveal a neon green underlining with silver trim. Sebek wears a white collared shirt and black tie underneath his coat.
Over the coat and above the waist is a set of black belts with silver buckles. The lowest belt hangs at an angle, and connects to several silver spools of thread on his left hip. Between the belt and spools is a silver ornament, shaped like a spinning wheel. On the other side of the belt is a holster for a magic pen. The black combat suspenders worn above the belts have silver buttons and a unique cuff around the right arm that resembles a dragon’s wing.
The jodhpur pants are black with neon green stripes going down the outer seams, and the knee-high boots are black with neon green soles. The garrison cap is black with neon green trim, and the sides fold up to resemble curved horns.

Personality: Sebek is loud, hot-blooded, and prideful. Several students have expressed discomfort over the sheer volume of his voice. Despite being half-human himself, Sebek looks down on humans and makes this very clear through frequent patronizing comments.
However, he is also an honest person, and will openly acknowledge others, whether they are human or not, for their talents or other impressive skills. He is blunt and not afraid to express his thoughts. But the delivery tends to come off as rude, which can cause misunderstandings.
Sebek greatly respects Malleus and Lilia, who he respectively calls Young Master and Master Lilia. He becomes much politer and meeker when addressing them. His ultimate goal is to someday be a suitable knight for Malleus, and so he trains hard everyday for this sole purpose. Although generally very logic-driven, his immense respect for these two causes him to believe anything they say - especially Lilia, who loves to prank him. Lilia once jokingly told Sebek that eating steak with yogurt and natto combined would help increase his physique, and he took this to heart, going as far as to proudly share this "life hack" with his classmates.
Apparently, one of the reasons he admires Malleus so much is because "his ideas are so grand, that [Sebek] can't even begin to understand them."

Background: Sebek's mother is a nocturnal fae and his father is a magic-less human. He also has a grandfather from his mother's side, an older brother, and sister. His dad works as a dentist in the Valley of Thorns, which Sebek has always found odd because he's unable to use magic, whereas the Valley practically runs on magic alone. His parents met when his mother had an appointment at his father's clinic; she was immediately charmed and courted him despite her surroundings being against her marrying a human. Currently, she works at the clinic as his assistant.
Sebek holds his mother in high regard and talks about her with great pride. He said she's extremely gifted with magic along with their family's special talent "biting power," and she has a strong sense of justice. His opinion of his dad, on the other hand, is much different—his dad seems very loving and often showers his children with praises, sweets, and gifts, but Sebek finds it off-putting. He doesn’t understand how his mother saw any appeal in him.

Signature Spell phrase: "Lightning, pierce the stormy skies! Living Bolt!"

entries.name: Grim WIP
entries.content:
Birthday: Unknown
Age: Unknown
Height: Approx. 70 cm
Dominant Hand: Forepaws
Appearance: Grim very closely resembles a cat. His fur is grey with a white patch at his chest and pink paw pads, and he has electric blue flames blazing from his ears. His eyes are also bright blue. Around his neck, he wears a black-and-white striped bow tie which is torn at the ends; it also bears a light purple gemstone that rests against his chest. His tail is shaped like a pitchfork.

Personality: The first time Yuuken meets Grim, he acts devilishly and mischievously, causing trouble wherever he goes. He can be quite narcissistic and prideful, often bragging about his magical abilities, despite not showing much magical prowess. At times, he goes to extreme lengths to achieve the things he desires, such as burning the welcoming ceremony hall to show off his magic in an attempt to get accepted to NRC. He likes getting attention from other people, as he joined the Spelldrive tournament just to get exposure through the show.
Aside from that, he is somewhat easy to impress and quite curious of things he is unfamiliar with, such as learning about the The Great Seven. He is also easy to taunt, such as when Ace insulted Yuuken and Grim for not knowing who the 7 figures were. Grim is shown to enjoy teasing people around him, most notably Yuuken, Ace and Deuce.
As the story progresses, he starts to enjoy the company of his friends, which includes Yuuken whom he spends most of his time with. Grim also becomes quite attached to Yuuken, often acting protectively or possessively over them. Although Grim does not usually act considerately or selflessly with other people, Grim does sometimes make an effort to do something nice for Yuuken or look out for them.

Background: Almost nothing is known about Grim's past and even he is unable to recall memories of his childhood other than waking up alone, hungry and cold. He was reportedly called “Grim The Digger” at home.
After a stormy start for causing chaos on campus, Grim finally manages to qualify to join Night Raven College along with Yuuken. While Yuuken waits to find a way home and Grim to become a great wizard, both try their hand at their current school life. As time progresses, Grim gets to know various students located in the school's seven dorms and learn about the more dangerous sides of magic: Overblot.
Yuuken and Grim are, in fact, involved in seven Overblots, which sees seven mages “blot” their magic wands due to negative emotions and thus abuse their magic. Since the Prologue after the defeat of each Phantom, Grim has managed to get his paws on a black stone and devour it, however, apparently at a cost.
When Grim ate the black stone leftover from Jamil's overblot, he began acting very strange and became addicted to eating more black stones. Grim's behavior became even more unstable after he ate the stone from Vil's overblot and grew more hostile. When he sensed Yuuken nearby at the colosseum, Grim attacked Yuuken in his belief that they were there to steal the stone from him.
Because of his "berserk" state and his disappearance, Ace, Deuce and Yuuken rely on Crowley to know how to deal with Grim. In Book 6, we find out from Crowley more about the black rocks eaten by Grim, explaining that he suspects that they are actually concentrated blot crystals.
However, Crowley explains that, Grim going “berserk” and attacking Yuuken may have just been his true nature, and he may have to expel Grim from the school. Grim seems to greatly regret attacking Yuuken at the end of Book 6, apologizing repeatedly once he has been saved.

Magical Skill: In addition to having a natural ability to use fire magic, Grim has shown the ability to draw on other magic and spells but with no strong talent. He has a problem with the precision of magic.
In Book 6, Idia confirms that Grim is not very powerful but the analysis team has detected ancient magic layered on top of each other within him that makes it impossible to accurately track Blot's accumulation. The current theory is that he possesses a curse or blessing that is activated only under conditional circumstances.
Always in Book 6 Riddle claims that Grim's magic is even cruder than Ace and Deuce's, further confirmed by Stryx researchers.

entries.name: Yuuken Enma WIP
entries.content:
Birthday: ?
Age: 16
Dominant Hand: Left
He is a second-year student of Hibari Municipal High School and vice-captain of the kendo club in his original world.
Appearances: Yuuken is a young, tall and rather handsome boy with black hair and cropped eyes black. During his time at Night Raven College, he's seen wearing his Hibari Municipal High School uniform, which consists of a green blazer, a white collared shirt and blue navy tie, black and white checked pants and sneakers white.
He is considered very tall and muscular by various characters, including Crowley.

Personality: Yuuken is a determined, responsible, thoughtful young man and a kind of vid naivety. He has a habit of helping anyone he sees in difficulty, even putting himself in danger, as when he rushes to push Riddle away and protect him with his body from Grim's attacks.
Yuuken has a certain desire to help people realize their dreams and feels a sort of weakness towards those who show an iron determination for their fulfillment, as seen with Grim making him remember his schoolmate Koito.
He has an open mind, given that he quickly gets used to the existence of magic, nor has he been scared at the sight of ghosts, on the contrary, he is thrilled to be able to see them even without magic much to their bewilderment.
He has a sincere talent for uniting people, as shown in the mine with Ace, Deuce, and Grim or in his original world when he unites enough members to join his kendo club. In addition to this, Yuuken shows enthusiasm and encourages other people, giving them advice or support in times of need.
He has a strong moral code and regardless of the person and their conduct he treats everyone equally, almost never showing fear. This strength is consolidated in moments of crisis: in the mine, for example, or when Leona tries to kick him.
However, Yuuken is not exempt from more adolescent behavior, such as watching anime.

Background: Not much is known about his life before Night Raven College. He was the vice-captain of his kendo club at a school in Tokyo and was able to gather new members, so that they would later be chosen to participate in their first official match in years. The NRC carriage arrived to pick him up late one evening while he was waiting for the bus, after he had helped a classmate train for an upcoming race.
Initially hired as a handyman, once he discovered his inability to use magic and return home, he was later brought in as a student half with Grim becoming Prefect of the Ramshackle dormitory.
He is given the Ghost Camera by Crowley to supervise Grim and document his life at the NRC without paperwork and joins the same class 1-A as Ace and Deuce following the lessons of Crewel, Trein and Vargas.

Skill: Despite being the only student without magical powers, Yuuken can handle himself and be useful to his friends. Yuuken was the vice-captain of the kendo club before being transferred to Twisted Wonderland and is obviously very skilled. He's also very passionate, having used kendo terms before hitting Grim or directing Ace and Deuce into a fight.
In addition to this, he follows a training that allows him not only to practice kendo but to have excellent physical prowess and resistance, which is shown when he completes 20 laps and 100 push-ups without sweating. He himself claims to train regularly.

entries.name: Known Rules
entries.content:
Known Rules

-Among the Housewarden's duties is to instruct new students on how to wear their robes.
-Another responsibility could be the welcoming party for new students that directly follows the orientation. 

Beyond Crowley and maybe the teachers, authorizing the use of magic against intruders seems to be decisively a Housewarden-only ability.
Lilia says that choosing the dorm’s Halloween costumes has to be done by either the Housewarden or Vice-Housewarden.
Memorizing student names may also be a Housewarden responsibility, although Idia admits that he knows almost none of the names.
For vice-housewardens, they seem to have the responsibility of supervising the dorms in the event that a Houswarden is unavailable.
Riddle also mentions needing to attend orientation rehearsal.

entries.name: Uncertaint rules
entries.content:
-Trey says that he can issue “a sleepover pass” as vice-housewarden, but it is unclear whether it is a power reserved for all Vice-Housewarden rather than something exclusive to Heartslabyul.
-Lilia says that students need the Housewarden’s permission to reserve the dorm lounge for events like parties, but it is not specified if this is a school rule or a Diasomnia rule.
